 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 21 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Just when you give up, rest your swords and hang up your boots, the cosmos kicks in surprises and momentum in your life. Virgo , it has not been an easy time for you. Your heart may have been feeling heavy, as though you may have been carrying an unspoken weight for a very long time. You asked the cosmos for respite, and it is coming in real soon. Bring out that feminine side of your personality (irrespective of your biological gender)—your intuition, your creativity, your ability to adapt and flow, your poise, your calm and your emotional and mental balance. Allow yourself to not keep pushing, and instead try receiving for a change. Things are about to go up a few notches, all for the better.
 Cosmic tip: Think long term and invest your energy wisely.
